children: Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian said in an interview with Fox News, through a translator, that Iran will follow international law on uranium enrichment. According to Sina Finance, he said Iran would defend itself if attacked, but added, "We absolutely do not want war."

Pezeshkian also said Iran has no connection with the Houthis and has not instructed them to take military action against others. According to Sina Finance, he said the Houthis are responsible for their own actions.

He added that Iran does not want a nuclear bomb and is willing to accept inspections on uranium. According to Sina Finance, he acknowledged that Iran faces economic problems but said he believes the country can overcome them.

title: Iranian President Pezeshkian Says Iran Will Follow International Law on Uranium Enrichment
